name: isCompactView
label: Compact view
description: Select to show the timeline on one line. The legend and title won't display

name: showCloseButton
label: Show close button
description: Shows a close button at the top right of timeline container

name: enableMarkers
label: Enable markers
description: Allows adding markers on timeline chart

name: markersConfig
label: Markers configuration
description: Object that defines marker icon, color, type, timestamps & date picker config to display on the timeline chart

name: formattedStartDate
label: Formatted start date
description: Formatted string of the minimum date that can be displayed in the timeline

name: formattedEndDate
label: Formatted end date
description: Formatted string of the maximum date that can be displayed in the timeline

name: formattedDisplayStartDate
label: Formatted display start date
description: Formatted string of optional starting date displayed on the timeline

name: formattedDisplayEndDate
label: Formatted display end date
description: Formatted string of optional ending date displayed on the timeline

name: locale
label: Locale
description: Locale string should be language code(ISO 639-1). E.x. 'ja' or 'de'

name: eventData
label: Event data
defaultValue: [{"name":"Agent Comment","icon":"headsetOutline","iconHref":"","color":"","label":"Agent Comment","labelPlural":"Agent Comment","events":[{"timestamp":1574744400000,"description":"Agent Comment #5","data":{}},{"timestamp":1569124800000,"description":"Agent Comment #8","data":{}}]},{"name":"Customer Comment","icon":"userOutline","iconHref":"","color":"","label":"Customer Comment","labelPlural":"Customer Comments","events":[{"timestamp":1568779200000,"description":"Customer Comment #2","data":{}},{"timestamp":1563163200000,"description":"Customer Comment #11","data":{}}]}]
description: Object array that defines the events to display on the timeline

name: rangeData
label: Range data
defaultValue: [{"name":"RangeA","color":"#5992E3","label":"Range type A","ranges":[{"start":1567656000000,"end":1568779200000,"description":"Range type A #2","data":{}}]},{"name":"RangeB","color":"#84B849","label":"Range type B","ranges":[{"start":1571112000000,"end":1573794000000,"description":"Range type B #3","data":{}}]}]
description: Object array that defines the ranges to display on the timeline

name: displayPopover
label: Display popover
description: Control how to display details for a point on timeline. Activate to display popover when timeline is clicked. Deactivate to display tooltip when cursor hovers on timeline

name: popoverMacroponent
label: Display popover macroponent
description: Add a macroponent that renders inside the popover

name: hidePadding
label: Hide padding
description: Hides the padding from timeline component

name: label
label: Label
description: Title to display at the top of the timeline

name: menuBarPosition
label: Menu bar position
description: Timeline action menu bar is shown at selected position

name: labelHeadingLevel
label: Label heading level
description: Defines the HTML <hx> heading element used to render the label

name: labelStyle
label: Label style
description: Header text style

name: hidePanZoom
label: Hide pan and zoom
description: Hides the pan and zoom buttons from the timeline display

name: minZoomSpread
label: Min. zoom spread
description: The minimum display range that is allowed for the zoom-in action. Y=Year, M=Month, D=Day, H=Hour, MN=Minute, S=Second, MS=Millisecond

name: hideNow
label: Hide now button
description: Hides the now-button from the timeline display

name: nowButtonLabel
label: Now button label
description: Label for Now zoom button

name: legendPosition
label: Legend position
description: Timeline legend dropdown is shown at selected position

name: legendTitle
label: Legend title
description: Title of timeline legend

name: legendEventTitle
label: Legend event title
description: The title used for events in the legend. Requires localization from the consuming component

name: legendRangeTitle
label: Legend range title
description: The title used for ranges in the legend. Requires localization from the consuming component

name: hideToggle
label: Hide legend toggle
description: Hides the toggle from the timeline legend display

name: isEmpty
label: Show empty state
description: Indicator of an empty state

name: emptyMessage
label: Empty state message
description: Message to display in an empty state

name: isError
label: Show error state
description: Indicator of error state

name: errorMessage
label: Error state message
defaultValue: This content could not be loaded
description: Message to display in an error state

name: isLoading
label: Show loading state
description: Indicator of loading state

name: loadingMessage
label: Loading state message
description: Message to display in a loading state

name: inUiBuilder
label: In UI Builder
description: Flag indicating that this timeline is configured inside a UI builder page

name: configAria
label: ARIA properties
description: Configures ARIA properties
